caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental object consisting of a rounded, vase-like top with a brass or gold-colored lid. The top section is adorned with two rows of vertical green designs; the upper row features oval, gem-like forms with pointed tops and rounded bases, while the lower row contains elongated oval shapes. The body of the object is primarily a light cream or off-white color. The top section is mounted on a gold-colored cylindrical neck that flares outwards and transitions into a structured, tiered base. The base is composed of a white, bell-shaped pedestal that sits atop a square platform with gold detailing around its perimeter, including a circular pattern in the center and delicate flourishes in the corners. The drawing is rendered on a cream-colored background with a lightly penciled rectangular border framing the object.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
